home.title: idopNetwork Web
home.hero.figure.alt: Multi-layer network diagram with M1, M2 and M3 nodes and directed edges
home.hero.intro: idopNetwork is a complex-systems framework built on the statistical mechanics proposed by Prof. Rongling Wu. Mapping static observations into a high-dimensional topological space lets us reconstruct the internal workings of a system beyond the limits of conventional statistics.
home.module.curve_fitting.title: Curve Fitting
home.module.curve_fitting.desc: Converts static data into quasi-dynamic power-law curves via niche theory and allometric growth, providing the mathematical base for the differential equations that follow.
home.module.funclu.title: FunClu
home.module.funclu.desc: Clusters traits into functional modules with a multivariate Gaussian mixture model, reducing the complexity of high-dimensional network reconstruction.
home.module.netrecon.title: NetRecon
home.module.netrecon.desc: Builds differential equations from evolutionary game theory and solves self- and interaction effects with constrained multi-task sparse regression, reconstructing a dynamic personalized network.
home.module.netanal.title: NetAnal
home.module.netanal.desc: Uses GLMY path homology to dissect the high-order structure of dynamic networks, tracking connected components, cycles and cavities across filtration thresholds.
home.profile.name: Prof. Rongling Wu
home.footer: Beijing Key Laboratory of Topological Statistics and Applications for Complex Systems · Beijing Institute of Mathematical Sciences and Applications · idopNetwork v2.0
home.badge.informative.tip: Turns complex data into interpretable biological or physical logic
home.badge.dynamic.tip: Captures how a system evolves over time and environments
home.badge.omnidirectional.tip: Covers interaction networks from molecules to phenotypes
